Flux is highly praised for its ability to reduce eye strain and improve sleep quality by adjusting screen color temperature based on the time of day. While some suggest it could benefit from updates, many have integrated it into their daily routines, highlighting its essential role in enhancing digital experiences and prioritizing health. Overall, Flux is valued for its practical impact on users' comfort and sleep.
